## Body

# plan:nav-trace-idle: review fix 31d1584fa (answers quokka's BLOCK on 8c451497f)

coder/trace-idle (pij-formal-mole), 2026-11-12. **31d1584fa on main**, on top of f23b70f58.

## Findings → fixes

| Quokka finding on 8c | Fix in 31d1584fa |
|---|---|
| P2: a file event in Tree mode left the tab-title attention marker stale, because `workingChanges` was fetched only while Changes showed. It also feeds the explorer and mobile badges. | Snapshot parts are now `{ status, recent }`. `status` = changed files, diff stats and working changes, fetched on mount and on every refresh. Only `recent` waits for the Changes panel. |
| P2: after a worktree switch, the old worktree's files still showed. | Loaded marks reset when `worktreePath` changes, and an answer that arrives for the old worktree is dropped. |
| P2: a refresh could run less than 2 s after the previous one (a pending timer was firing alongside the resume refresh; or the tab was shown again 200 ms after a refresh). | One scheduler (`requestRefresh`) runs every automatic refresh no earlier than max(min delay, 2 s after the last refresh started). The visibility resume uses min delay 0, and a refresh already waiting covers newer changes. The refresh button runs at once and resets the clock. |
| LOW: after an idle first window that only received a hello frame, the first real connect was flagged as a routine reopen and logged at debug. | `afterRecycle` is set only when the recycled socket had reached `connected`. |

## Evidence

- **Full fft** (on the commit before its rebase over f23b70f58): `/tmp/trace-idle/fft-fix.log` (`fft-fix.meta`).
  - Ran 17:36:35–17:45:57, load 52 → 30, exit 0.
  - biome: 1812 files, no fixes. turbo build: 7/7. All 9 tsconfigs typechecked.
  - Tests: 556 files passed (7 skipped); 7336 tests passed.
  - `pnpm audit --audit-level=high`: passed (3 low, 16 moderate).
- **After rebasing over f23b70f58:** 55 affected test files (589 tests) green — rs-event-stream, rs-bootstrap and 041-file-browser.
- **New tests:**
  - `use-panel-state.test.tsx`: working changes stay current in Tree mode; a worktree switch reloads and drops the old worktree's answer; a throttled refresh pending at resume covers the hidden changes; a resume 200 ms after a refresh waits until +2000 ms.
  - `rs-event-stream.test.ts`: a first window with no events still logs the first connect at info.
- **Quokka's spacing probe** `/tmp/reviewer-trace-spacing.test.tsx`: passes against this tree (calls `[2000]`, no call at 2200). I ran it as a scratch copy and deleted it.
- **Live proof on the kept build** (`/tmp/trace-idle/attention-probe.mjs` → `/tmp/trace-idle/attention-proof.json`). Tree mode, browser page with `?worktree=` set to the fix worktree, at load ~31:
  - With a clean tree the title has no ❗.
  - After creating an untracked file, one `fetchChangesSnapshot {status:true, recent:false}` runs and the title shows ❗.
  - After deleting the file, one snapshot runs and the ❗ clears. Before the fix it stayed.
  - On the hide → change → show sequence, the refresh on resume ran 4.4 s after the previous one, so the 2 s spacing was already met.
  - The probe did not exercise the 200 ms resume case; the unit test covers it.
- **Kept build:**
  - Worktree `/Users/jordanknight/substrate/chainglass-trace-idle-fix` at 31d1584fa, `apps/web/.next/BUILD_ID` = `4YdtdT4qRVdlxuGMU4VK9` (17:47).
  - The manifest exports `fetchChangesSnapshot`, and the server chunk uses `.status` and `.recent`.
  - To serve it: `env -u TMUX -u TMUX_PANE TMUX_TMPDIR=/tmp/trace-idle-tmux nice -n 19 pnpm exec next start --port 3106`, with no sidecar. I proved the socket path is under that directory, and the server is stopped now.

## Still true from 8c451497f

The idle results did not change. The workspace and pij pages make 0 server-action calls, both on load and in 60 s idle. With the status part now fetched on every refresh, the browser page sends 1 `fetchChangesSnapshot` per throttled file-change refresh. The pij-rs stream logs one info connect per server start and reconnects every 10 min.
